npc_0.name: Father Cavin
npc_0.description: A blind priest in tattered robes. He constantly washes his hands in an empty bowl.

0: A year... or a century? God stopped counting our days when the King went mad.
I remember the screams of the Queen, but her face... it is washed away from my mind.
Who are you under that iron mask, mute stranger? Another ghost of this cursed palace?
1: Leave me to my prayers. Your iron mask reflects my own sins.
God gave us blood to suffer, not to fight. Go away.
